message: No detected input validation: The code reads raw text files and parses them with basic string splitting and a bare try/except for IndexError, but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: The BERT model and tokenizer are loaded from a local path (args.bert_path) and data files are read from a local directory; no checksum verification, pinned revisions, or authentication for any remote source is present.

No detected label flipping detection: The code maps labels to IDs and reads them from files but performs no validation against an expected set, distribution comparison, or noise detection to catch label-flipping anomalies.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code reads raw text, tokenizes, and creates features without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs that would defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained BERT weights via `BertTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.bert_path)` and constructs models from `args.bert_path` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads labels and creates id mappings but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection of any kind in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is AdamW without any DP-SGD wrapper; no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or other differential privacy library is imported or applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation from training data, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference/evaluation path loads and processes data without any shape/range validation, schema checks, or rejection of malformed inputs beyond a bare IndexError print in read_text.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is present that checks model outputs for NaN values, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated thresholds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a BERT-based NER model, not an LLM, and no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation is implemented anywhere in the visible code.
